annotations.title: Get Event Nexus Queuing and Pit Map

description: Retrieve live match-queuing info and the pit map for an event from Nexus (frc.nexus), as cached by TBA. Returns the match now queuing, per-match queue status (Queuing soon, Now queuing, On deck, On field) with estimated queue and start times, and the pit map (pit positions with assigned team keys, areas, labels, walls). Queuing data only exists while an event is running; returns null when neither queuing info nor a pit map is available.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.
